question: Would you rather be with someone who genuinely loves you but manipulates you to keep you around, or someone who treats you perfectly but would leave you tomorrow if someone better came along?
Would you rather make your partner insecure enough that they never leave you or make them confident enough to realise they deserve better?
Would you rather stay with someone you no longer love because they would be destroyed by the breakup or leave them knowing they might never recover emotionally?
Would you rather have your partner cry every time you threaten to leave or watch them calmly accept the breakup because they have already emotionally moved on?
Would you rather be the person your partner settles for or the person they obsess over but know they should never date?
Would you rather deliberately make your partner jealous to test their love or secretly enjoy watching them become jealous without admitting you're responsible?
Would you rather have your partner forgive every terrible thing you do or have them remember everything and use it against you whenever you argue?
Would you rather be loved because your partner is terrified of being alone or be desired because your partner thinks you're difficult to obtain?
Would you rather tell your partner exactly what they need to hear to keep the relationship alive or tell them the truth and watch the relationship collapse?
Would you rather have your partner depend on you emotionally while you secretly resent them or depend on your partner while secretly knowing you could do better?
Would you rather date someone who constantly tests your loyalty or someone who never tests you because they have already decided you will disappoint them?
Would you rather have your partner believe you are their soulmate when you know they're not yours or believe they're your soulmate when they see you as temporary?
Would you rather stay with someone who has become emotionally exhausting or become the emotionally exhausting person someone else stays with out of guilt?
Would you rather be the reason someone develops trust issues or the person who knowingly dates someone with trust issues because you enjoy having the upper hand?
Would you rather have your partner forgive you for something unforgivable or discover that they did something worse and are staying only because they feel guilty?
Would you rather be with someone who loves you more every day while you love them less or someone who becomes less interested in you the more you love them?
Would you rather fake vulnerability to make someone fall for you or hide your real vulnerability because you know they'll use it against you?
Would you rather make someone feel like the luckiest person alive before abandoning them or stay with them while privately believing they are lucky you tolerate them?
Would you rather be the partner who always threatens to leave but never does or the partner who silently prepares to leave while pretending everything is fine?
Would you rather have someone love you for your potential or love you exactly as you are while knowing you will never become the person you promised to be?
Would you rather cheat once and confess immediately or never physically cheat but spend years secretly wishing you were with someone else?
Would you rather discover your partner cheated with your best friend or discover your best friend knew your partner was cheating and helped them hide it?
Would you rather forgive your partner for a one-night stand or forgive them for months of flirting, secret dates and emotional intimacy with someone else?
Would you rather be cheated on by someone who genuinely regrets it or cheat on someone you genuinely love and know you will never tell them?
Would you rather have your partner cheat on you with someone more attractive or someone less attractive who they claim understands them better?
Would you rather confess that you cheated because you were bored or confess that you cheated because you had developed genuine feelings for the other person?
Would you rather be the affair partner who is promised a future that never arrives or the official partner who is kept around because you are convenient?
Would you rather discover that your partner has a secret dating profile or that they have been using dating apps only to see whether they can still attract people?
Would you rather cheat with your ex and risk losing your current partner or remain faithful while secretly keeping your ex as your emotional backup?
Would you rather have your partner admit they cheated because you neglected them or admit they cheated because they wanted to see whether they could get away with it?
Would you rather be forgiven for cheating but never trusted again or be trusted completely by someone who would leave you instantly if they knew the truth?
Would you rather know that your partner cheated but never know how many times or know every detail and be unable to stop imagining it?
Would you rather be someone's first choice publicly but their second choice privately or their second choice publicly but their first choice whenever nobody else is around?
Would you rather discover that your partner cheated during your happiest period together or during the period when you were struggling and needed them most?
Would you rather have your partner confess an affair because they feel guilty or confess because the affair partner is threatening to expose them?
Would you rather have an open relationship your partner genuinely wants but you secretly hate or a monogamous relationship your partner secretly resents?
Would you rather have your partner cheat and blame alcohol or cheat while completely sober and insist it meant nothing?
Would you rather be the person someone cheats with while believing their relationship is already over or the person who knowingly lies to the betrayed partner to protect the affair?
Would you rather discover your partner has cheated with multiple strangers or has repeatedly returned to the same person they claim to hate?
Would you rather admit you would cheat if guaranteed you would never be caught or admit you would leave your partner immediately if someone richer, more attractive and more successful wanted you?
Would you rather be the rebound your partner genuinely falls in love with or the long-term partner they use to prove they have moved on?
Would you rather discover your partner still checks their ex's social media every day or discover their ex still has more influence over their decisions than you do?
Would you rather have your partner admit they would return to their ex if the ex asked or admit they only started dating you to make their ex jealous?
Would you rather marry someone who still loves their ex or spend your life wondering whether your partner will ever love you as much as they loved their ex?
Would you rather have your ex beg for you back after you have moved on or watch your ex find the happiness you desperately wanted to give them?
Would you rather be the person your ex compares every future partner to or the person your ex pretends never mattered?
Would you rather discover that your partner has kept every gift from their ex or that they threw away everything you gave them after a minor argument?
Would you rather have your partner remain friends with an ex they once planned to marry or cut off that ex but secretly resent you for asking?
Would you rather date someone who has never gotten over their first love or someone who has never genuinely loved anyone long enough to be heartbroken?
Would you rather have your ex tell your new partner every embarrassing detail about you or have your new partner ask your ex for relationship advice?
Would you rather get back together with someone who broke your heart because they genuinely changed or because every other person they dated rejected them?
Would you rather be your partner's favourite ex or their current partner who secretly knows their ex understood them better?
Would you rather have your partner admit that their ex was better in bed or that their ex was a better person than you?
Would you rather discover your partner has been comparing your relationship to their previous one or that they have deliberately repeated the mistakes that destroyed it?
Would you rather spend a night with your ex knowing it will ruin your current relationship or spend the rest of your life wondering what would have happened if you had?
Would you rather have your ex marry someone they truly love or remain single forever while privately hoping you return?
Would you rather be the person your partner dates immediately after a breakup or the person they contact years later only when their life falls apart?
Would you rather discover that your partner has been hiding how serious their previous relationship was or discover that they exaggerated how terrible their ex was to make you feel superior?
Would you rather have your partner confess that you remind them of their ex or that they deliberately chose you because you are nothing like their ex?
Would you rather be someone's unfinished business or their final lesson before they meet the person they actually want?
Would you rather have a partner who is obsessed with your body but indifferent to your personality or obsessed with your personality but barely physically attracted to you?
Would you rather have your partner admit that your chemistry is terrible but your compatibility is perfect or that your chemistry is incredible but your relationship is doomed?
Would you rather discover that your partner fakes their enthusiasm for intimacy to protect your feelings or that they genuinely enjoy intimacy but never with you as much as with an ex?

Would you rather be the best physical experience your partner has ever had but the worst relationship they've ever been in or the best relationship they've ever had but the least exciting physical connection?
Would you rather have your partner tell you exactly how you compare physically to every ex or refuse to answer because the truth would hurt you?
Would you rather have your partner constantly initiate intimacy but rarely show affection outside the bedroom or shower you with affection while never initiating intimacy?
Would you rather discover that your partner has been pretending to enjoy your romantic gestures or that they enjoy them only because they make you easier to manipulate?
Would you rather have your partner admit that they were initially embarrassed to be seen with you or that they are now embarrassed to admit they ever doubted you?
Would you rather be physically irresistible to someone who doesn't respect you or deeply respected by someone who isn't physically attracted to you?
Would you rather have your partner fantasise about someone they know personally or admit that they rarely fantasise about you at all?

Would you rather have your partner tell their friends intimate details about your relationship or discover that they have never mentioned your physical relationship because they find it underwhelming?
Would you rather be with someone who wants intimacy mainly to feel loved or someone who wants it mainly to feel desirable?
Would you rather have your partner admit they settled for your looks because of your personality or settled for your personality because of your looks?
Would you rather discover that your partner has secretly rated your attractiveness out of ten or that they have asked their friends whether they could do better than you?
Would you rather have your partner prefer your physical affection but dislike your emotional needs or prefer your emotional support but avoid physical closeness?
Would you rather be the person your partner desires but would never introduce to their family or the person their family adores but whom they secretly find unattractive?
Would you rather have your partner tell you their most embarrassing intimate insecurity or have them reveal the insecurity of yours they find least attractive?
Would you rather have incredible chemistry with someone who constantly disrespects your boundaries or comfortable intimacy with someone who treats you well but whom you rarely desire?
Would you rather discover that your partner has been pretending to be satisfied with your physical relationship or that they are satisfied but have secretly mocked your insecurities to their friends?
Would you rather have someone desire you intensely for a month and then lose interest or remain attracted to you for decades while never feeling deeply in love with you?
Would you rather marry your soulmate knowing you will struggle financially forever or marry someone you barely love who guarantees you a comfortable life?
Would you rather propose because you genuinely want to marry your partner or because you know they will leave if you don't?
Would you rather have your partner admit they are marrying you because you're a good choice on paper or discover that they are marrying you because everyone expects them to?
Would you rather spend 40 years with someone you love but who makes you miserable or spend 40 years with someone you like but never truly love?
Would you rather discover that your spouse regrets marrying you or realise that you regret marrying them but are too afraid to leave?
Would you rather have a partner who wants children mainly to satisfy their parents or a partner who agrees to remain child-free but secretly resents you?
Would you rather divorce someone who still loves you or stay married to someone who respects you but no longer wants you?
Would you rather have your partner admit they married you too young or admit they would never marry you if they met you today?
Would you rather be the spouse who sacrifices everything for the marriage or the spouse who benefits from those sacrifices while quietly feeling trapped?
Would you rather discover that your spouse has been planning a divorce for a year or that they have considered leaving you every month but stayed out of convenience?
Would you rather have your partner prioritise your marriage over their ambitions and resent you forever or prioritise their ambitions and leave you feeling abandoned?
Would you rather marry someone who is loyal but emotionally unavailable or someone who is emotionally devoted but has repeatedly crossed your boundaries?
Would you rather have your spouse admit they married you because you were the safest option or that they married you because they thought you would never leave?
Would you rather celebrate your tenth anniversary knowing your spouse has never been fully satisfied or end the marriage knowing you were the reason they finally became happy?
Would you rather stay together for your children while secretly resenting each other or separate and have your children blame you for the rest of their lives?
Would you rather have your spouse's family believe you are the problem or have your own family believe your spouse deserves better than you?

Would you rather discover that your spouse has a detailed plan for life after your death or that they have never thought about a future without you because they assume you will always take care of everything?
Would you rather have your spouse stay faithful because of their principles or because they know nobody else would want them?
Would you rather renew your vows while secretly wanting to leave or refuse to renew them and destroy the last bit of hope your partner has?
Would you rather know on your wedding day that your partner has doubts about marrying you or discover 20 years later that they never wanted to marry you in the first place?
Would you rather have a partner who checks your phone every night or a partner who never checks your phone because they assume you're hiding something worse?
Would you rather be forbidden from seeing one particular friend because your partner is jealous or be allowed to see them while knowing your partner secretly resents every interaction?
Would you rather have a partner who demands constant reassurance or one who never asks for reassurance because they have emotionally checked out?
Would you rather have your partner control your social life out of insecurity or let you do anything you want while making you feel guilty afterward?
Would you rather have your partner become jealous whenever someone compliments you or become suspicious whenever nobody seems interested in you?
Would you rather have your partner know your passwords because they trust you or demand them because they don't?
Would you rather have your partner dislike every attractive person you know or flirt with attractive people themselves and accuse you of being insecure when you object?
Would you rather be with someone who wants to know your every move or someone who never asks where you've been because they don't particularly care?
Would you rather have your partner secretly monitor your social media activity or openly interrogate you about every person who interacts with your posts?
Would you rather have your partner tell you who you can and cannot be friends with or let you keep every friendship while privately sabotaging the ones they dislike?
Would you rather have your partner accuse you of cheating whenever you go out or constantly joke about cheating themselves while insisting they are completely faithful?
Would you rather have your partner become more possessive the more successful you become or become less interested in you the more independent you become?
Would you rather date someone who treats your independence as a threat or someone who treats your need for affection as a weakness?
Would you rather have your partner demand to know your entire romantic history or refuse to tell you anything about theirs while judging every detail of yours?
Would you rather have your partner publicly claim you as theirs but privately neglect you or privately adore you but refuse to acknowledge your relationship publicly?
Would you rather have your partner pick fights whenever you spend time with friends or become unusually affectionate whenever you threaten to leave?
Would you rather have your partner resent your closest friend because they know that friend understands you better or resent your family because they know you would choose them over your partner?
Would you rather have a partner who tries to change everything about you or one who constantly reminds you that they could find someone better?
Would you rather have your partner become jealous of your past or become jealous of the future you might have without them?
Would you rather have someone love you so intensely that you feel trapped or love someone so intensely that you become the person you swore you would never be?
Would you rather confess your feelings to your best friend and lose the friendship or remain their closest confidant while watching them fall in love with someone else?
Would you rather discover that your partner has feelings for your best friend but has never acted on them or discover that they have no feelings for your best friend but secretly wish they did?
Would you rather be someone's secret crush for ten years or their openly acknowledged partner for ten months before they lose interest?
Would you rather fall in love with someone who is emotionally unavailable or be loved by someone you know you will never feel the same way about?
Would you rather tell someone you love them purely to stop them from moving on or let them move on knowing you may regret it forever?
Would you rather have your best friend confess that they've always wanted you or confess that they once wanted you but no longer do?
Would you rather be the person someone emotionally cheats with or the partner who receives all the affection while unknowingly being cheated on emotionally?
Would you rather have someone secretly love you while publicly criticising you or publicly adore you while privately feeling nothing for you?
Would you rather discover that your partner has a crush on their colleague or that their colleague has a crush on them and your partner secretly enjoys the attention?
Would you rather be someone's almost-relationship that they never forget or their official relationship that they barely remember?
Would you rather confess that you have feelings for someone else's partner or discover that someone you love has been waiting for your relationship to fail?
Would you rather have your partner admit they would date your best friend if you broke up or admit that your best friend has already confessed their attraction to them?
Would you rather love someone who only wants you when you're unavailable or be the person who only wants someone when they start moving on?
Would you rather have someone choose you over their lifelong dream or have them pursue their dream and quietly blame you for not waiting?
Would you rather be the person someone cheats on their partner with because they claim you're special or the partner who is told that the affair meant nothing?
Would you rather have your partner confess they once loved someone more than you or confess that they've never loved anyone as much as themselves?
Would you rather find out that your secret admirer is someone you dislike or that the person you secretly admire finds you completely uninteresting?
Would you rather have your partner admit that they still wonder what life would be like with someone else or admit that they know exactly what life would be like and prefer it?
Would you rather be someone's forbidden temptation or their convenient escape from a relationship they refuse to end?
Would you rather spend your life wondering whether you missed your chance with the right person or knowing you had your chance and deliberately chose someone else?
Would you rather break someone's heart in the most honest way possible or let them slowly lose confidence because you cannot admit that you no longer love them?
Would you rather have your ex move on within a week or discover that they spent a year pretending to be over you while secretly hoping you'd return?
Would you rather be dumped because your partner found someone better or because they finally realised you were never right for them?
Would you rather end a relationship because you are unhappy or stay until your partner finally becomes the one who leaves?
Would you rather have your ex tell everyone you were a terrible partner while secretly knowing they are right or defend you publicly while privately believing they wasted years with you?
Would you rather apologise to someone you hurt knowing they will never forgive you or never apologise and spend the rest of your life pretending you did nothing wrong?
Would you rather have your ex regret losing you but never contact you or contact you constantly while making it clear they only want attention?
Would you rather leave someone while they are at their lowest point or stay with them until you become so resentful that you treat them terribly?
Would you rather have your ex expose your worst relationship behaviour or discover that your ex has told everyone a version of the breakup that makes them look innocent?
Would you rather break up with someone you love because you know you're bad for them or stay because you cannot bear the thought of them loving someone else?
Would you rather find out that your ex was happier with you than they are now or that breaking up with you was the best decision they ever made?
Would you rather have someone leave you without an explanation or receive an explanation that confirms every insecurity you have?
Would you rather be the person who ends a relationship and immediately regrets it or the person who gets dumped and spends years hoping the other person regrets it?
Would you rather have your partner break up with you over text or stay together for six months after deciding they no longer love you?
Would you rather be remembered by your ex as the love of their life who hurt them or as a forgettable relationship that taught them what they never wanted again?
Would you rather have your ex return because they genuinely love you or because their new relationship failed?
Would you rather discover that your ex never loved you or discover that they loved you deeply but you destroyed the relationship through your own behaviour?
Would you rather be the person who walks away too early or the person who stays so long that they become someone they hate?
Would you rather watch your ex give their new partner everything you begged for or realise that you never actually wanted those things until someone else received them?

Would you rather have one final conversation with your ex in which they tell you everything they hated about you or never speak again and spend the rest of your life imagining what they would have said?
Would you rather date someone with all the standards you demand from others but cannot meet yourself or someone who meets none of your standards but treats you better than anyone else?
Would you rather admit that you judge potential partners for their past while hiding your own or admit that your standards change whenever someone attractive enough comes along?
Would you rather reject someone because they are not ambitious enough and later discover they became extremely successful or date someone successful and discover they think you're beneath them?
Would you rather be loved for your money, status and appearance or be loved for your personality by someone you are not attracted to?
Would you rather demand complete loyalty while keeping a backup option yourself or demand total honesty while knowing you would punish your partner for telling the truth?
Would you rather date someone who has your exact flaws or someone who constantly criticises your flaws while possessing worse ones?
Would you rather have your partner earn less than you and feel insecure about it or earn much more than you and use it to win every argument?
Would you rather be rejected for your financial situation by someone you genuinely love or reject someone you genuinely love because their financial situation embarrasses you?
Would you rather admit that you care more about looks than you claim or that you care more about status than you are willing to acknowledge?
Would you rather be with someone who meets all your expectations but bores you or someone who excites you but repeatedly fails to meet your expectations?
Would you rather date someone who openly admits they are selfish or someone who insists they are selfless while expecting you to sacrifice everything?
Would you rather have your partner call you out for every double standard you have or never challenge you because they know you cannot handle being wrong?
Would you rather stay with someone because they are objectively a good catch or leave someone wonderful because you are convinced you can do better?
Would you rather have your partner judge your romantic past by the same standards you use to judge theirs or discover that they have a far more complicated past than they initially admitted?
Would you rather be the person who demands emotional maturity but refuses to communicate or the person who communicates constantly but never changes their behaviour?
Would you rather have a partner who is honest about finding other people attractive or one who pretends you are the only attractive person in the world?
Would you rather discover that your partner has been lowering their standards to stay with you or that they believe you have been lowering yours to stay with them?
Would you rather be with someone who challenges every selfish thing you do or someone who enables your worst behaviour because they are afraid of losing you?
Would you rather be rejected by someone who shares your values but has higher standards or accepted by someone who shares none of your values but desperately wants you?
Would you rather admit that you want a partner who is better than you in every way or admit that you would resent them if they actually were?

Would you rather find your soulmate at the wrong time and spend your life wondering what could have been or marry the right person at the right time while secretly wondering whether someone better exists?
Would you rather know that your partner is your soulmate but that you are not theirs or know that you are their soulmate but you will never feel the same way about them?
Would you rather have a partner who would sacrifice their life for you but refuses to compromise on anything small or one who makes daily sacrifices but would choose themselves in a genuine crisis?
Would you rather marry someone who knows every terrible thing you've done and still loves you or someone who loves an idealised version of you and would leave if they knew the truth?
Would you rather have a partner who makes you a better person but leaves you feeling inadequate or one who makes you feel amazing about yourself while enabling your worst habits?

Would you rather have your partner admit that you are not the love of their life but the best person to build a life with or admit that you are the love of their life but they don't trust you enough to marry you?
Would you rather be with someone who knows you are settling for them or someone who believes you are perfect for each other while you secretly disagree?
Would you rather discover that your partner would choose their family over you in every serious conflict or that they would abandon their family for you and expect you to do the same?
Would you rather be someone's greatest love who arrives too late or their first love whom they eventually outgrow?
Would you rather have a partner who is completely honest about their doubts regarding you or one who hides those doubts to protect your feelings?
Would you rather be with someone who forgives your worst behaviour but never forgets it or someone who forgets your mistakes but repeatedly makes the same ones themselves?
Would you rather discover that your partner believes they deserve better than you or that they believe you deserve better than them and are staying out of guilt?

Would you rather have your partner say they would choose you in every lifetime but treat you poorly in this one or treat you perfectly in this life but admit they would make a different choice in another?
Would you rather be the person your partner grows old with but never stops wondering about someone else or the person they never forget but never get to grow old with?
Would you rather have a partner who is faithful because they love you or faithful because they lack the courage to leave?
Would you rather know that your partner has imagined a better life without you or know that they cannot imagine a future without you because they have no identity outside the relationship?
Would you rather be the person who gets everything they want from a relationship but never feels fully loved or the person who is deeply loved but never gets the relationship they actually want?

Would you rather have your partner tell you that you are the best person they've ever dated but not the person they have loved most or the person they have loved most but the worst partner they've ever had?

Would you rather spend your life with someone who knows you are not their first choice but chooses you every day or someone who claims you are their first choice but would leave the moment life became difficult?
Would you rather discover, on your tenth anniversary, that your partner has always secretly believed they settled for you or admit that you have always secretly believed you settled for them?
Would you rather have your best friend secretly hate your personality or secretly be jealous of everything you've achieved?
Would you rather find out your entire friend group has a separate group chat without you or that they have one specifically to discuss your flaws?
Would you rather betray your best friend to protect five other friends or betray five friends to protect your best friend?
Would you rather have a friend who would lie to the police for you or a friend who would tell you the truth even if it ruined your life?
Would you rather discover that your best friend has been copying your personality or quietly competing with you for years?
Would you rather have your friends love you but never respect you or respect you but secretly find you insufferable?
Would you rather be the least favourite person in your friend group or the person everyone likes only because you are useful?
Would you rather have your best friend expose your most embarrassing secret to win an argument or abandon you when you genuinely need them?
Would you rather forgive a friend who betrayed you once in a life-changing way or lose a friend who has disappointed you in small ways for years?
Would you rather know which friend would sell you out for $10,000 or which friend would abandon you to save their own reputation?
Would you rather have your friends defend you when you're wrong or confront you privately and refuse to defend you publicly?
Would you rather find out that your closest friend has always considered you their backup friend or that they only became close to you because their first choice rejected them?
Would you rather save a ten-year friendship by accepting blame for something you didn't do or tell the truth and destroy the friendship?
Would you rather have a friend who constantly humiliates you as a joke or a friend who praises you to your face but mocks you behind your back?
Would you rather discover that your friends invited you out of pity or that they invited you because they wanted you to pay?
Would you rather lose every friend who has ever lied to you or lose every friend you've ever lied to?
Would you rather have your best friend choose their romantic partner over you once or choose a random new friend over you every single time?
Would you rather be remembered as the friend who always showed up but was never appreciated or the friend who rarely showed up but was always missed?
Would you rather expose a friend's hypocrisy in front of everyone or let them continue judging other people for things they secretly do themselves?
Would you rather learn that your friends think you're a bad person for a valid reason or that they think you're a good person because they don't know the real you?
Would you rather have your entire search history revealed to your friends or have every private message you've ever sent read aloud to your family?
Would you rather reveal the worst thing you've ever done or the worst thing you've ever seriously considered doing?
Would you rather have your most embarrassing insecurity exposed or your most selfish motivation behind a supposedly kind act exposed?
Would you rather let your friends read your diary or listen to every voice note you've recorded but never sent?
Would you rather reveal the person you secretly resent the most or the person whose approval you desperately crave?
Would you rather have everyone know your biggest lie or have everyone believe a terrible lie about you that you cannot disprove?
Would you rather expose your own hypocrisy or be exposed by someone who has been collecting evidence against you?
Would you rather reveal the meanest thing you've ever said about your best friend or the meanest thing they've ever said about you?
Would you rather have your private thoughts about everyone in the room displayed anonymously or have everyone guess which thought belongs to you?
Would you rather confess to a lie that benefited you for years or keep the benefits while knowing an innocent person is still blamed?
Would you rather have your most humiliating moment go viral or have your most morally questionable decision become known to everyone you respect?
Would you rather admit that you've been jealous of a friend's success or admit that you secretly enjoyed watching them fail?
Would you rather reveal the worst reason you've ever rejected someone or the worst reason someone might have rejected you?
Would you rather let your friends see the messages you deleted or the messages you typed out but never sent?
Would you rather confess every time you've pretended to care about someone or every time you've pretended not to care?
Would you rather have everyone know your real opinion of them or know their real opinion of you?
Would you rather reveal the biggest secret you've kept from your partner or the biggest secret you've kept from your family?
Would you rather have your most shameful financial decision exposed or your most shameful relationship decision exposed?
Would you rather reveal the time you knowingly took credit for someone else's work or the time you let someone else take the blame for yours?
Would you rather have one person discover your darkest secret or have a thousand strangers believe a false, humiliating story about you?
Would you rather find out your partner is still in love with their ex or that they've never been genuinely attracted to you?
Would you rather have your partner admit they've compared you unfavourably to every ex or discover they've kept a secret ranking of everyone they've dated?
Would you rather date someone your best friend secretly loves or let your best friend date someone you still have feelings for?
Would you rather have your partner read every message you've ever exchanged with your ex or have your ex read every message you've exchanged with your current partner?
Would you rather be cheated on once and never find out or discover that your partner has been emotionally unfaithful for years?
Would you rather marry someone who loves you more than you love them or someone you love more than they love you?
Would you rather have your partner reveal that you're their second choice or discover that you're the person they settled for after being rejected by their first choice?
Would you rather have your ex become your best friend's spouse or your best friend become your ex's closest confidant?
Would you rather have your partner reveal your most embarrassing intimate secret to their best friend or reveal your worst relationship argument to their entire family?
Would you rather forgive your partner for cheating with a stranger or for developing feelings for your best friend without acting on them?
Would you rather be loved for a version of yourself that isn't real or rejected after someone discovers who you really are?
Would you rather have your partner secretly dislike your friends or have your friends secretly dislike your partner?
Would you rather discover that your partner has been faking happiness in the relationship or that they've been staying with you out of guilt?
Would you rather tell your friend that their partner is cheating with evidence that will destroy their relationship or stay silent and let them remain happy for now?
Would you rather have your partner choose their career over you or choose you and resent you for the rest of their life?
Would you rather be someone's secret lover for five years or their publicly acknowledged partner whom they privately regret choosing?
Would you rather discover that your partner has been lying about their past or that they've been telling the truth but judging you for yours?
Would you rather have your partner's ex know them better than you ever will or have your partner's friends know more about your relationship than you do?
Would you rather reunite with the person who broke your heart or permanently lose the person who treated you well but whom you never truly loved?
Would you rather know exactly why every person you've ever loved left you or never know whether anyone you've dated truly loved you?
Would you rather steal medicine to save a stranger's life or obey the law and let them suffer?
Would you rather expose a corrupt person you love or protect them and allow innocent people to suffer the consequences?
Would you rather punish someone for a crime they committed if doing so would ruin their innocent family's lives or let them escape justice?
Would you rather lie under oath to protect an innocent person or tell the truth knowing the legal system will punish them unfairly?
Would you rather donate $100,000 anonymously or donate $1 million publicly while knowing your main motivation is admiration?
Would you rather help someone because you genuinely care but receive no recognition or help them solely for praise and save their life?
Would you rather forgive a person who never apologises or demand an apology from someone who has genuinely changed?
Would you rather expose a respected charity's corruption and risk destroying its useful work or keep quiet so it can continue helping people?
Would you rather report your closest colleague for misconduct and lose your friendship or cover it up and risk an innocent colleague being blamed?
Would you rather punish everyone equally even when their circumstances differ or treat people differently based on what you believe they deserve?
Would you rather save one innocent person by framing a guilty person for a different crime or refuse to frame anyone and risk the innocent person being punished?
Would you rather admit publicly that your beliefs were wrong or quietly change your behaviour without ever acknowledging your past?
Would you rather return a lost wallet containing $50,000 if nobody could ever know what you did or keep it knowing the owner desperately needs the money?
Would you rather expose a friend's racist, sexist or otherwise hateful private comments or give them a chance to change without public consequences?
Would you rather tell a painful truth that destroys someone's confidence or tell a comforting lie that helps them move forward?
